reviews.product: Elgato Facecam Pro Privacy Cover
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ **10/10 – Perfect Fit & Clean Look**

Great privacy cover for the Elgato Facecam Pro. It fits perfectly, feels well made, and gives me peace of mind when I’m not using the camera. It also looks clean and doesn’t take away from the premium look of the Facecam Pro. Simple product, but it does exactly what it’s supposed to do. Definitely recommend!

reviews.name: Etsy Customer
reviews.product: Under-Desk Mount for Elgato Wave XLR Pro
reviews.text: Great build. The screws that come with are great, but will get the job down if you drill pilot holes if attaching to wood. I would ask for an improvement to be made by printing a version that has the thread port on the bottom exposed to allow for attachments but primarily a way to have a little 3d printed "locking" screw that would prevent the unit from being pulled out when unplugging headphones or such.
